Name: S1.1 Request + acquire manual gold assets (drop .docx/.pptx) ★
Description: Send the leadership request by EOW before Sprint 1 (Fri 5 Jun) so files are in hand Mon 8 Jun; this task = confirm receipt + drop the .docx/.pptx into benchmark/m1_s1/. #1 external dependency — Sprint 1's Thu/Fri slack is the slip buffer.

Name: S1.2 Extract manual assets → text (one-off)
Description: Convert the manual .docx/.pptx into plain-text files — one-off, no parsing pipeline.

Name: S1.3 Confirm assets complete / fallback decision ◆
Description: Skim the extracted assets; confirm they're complete enough to benchmark, else pick a fallback subtopic.

Name: S1.4 Build hand-built gold reference content_package.json
Description: Hand-build the gold-standard content_package.json from the manual assets (agent-output schema) to score against.

Name: S1.5 Write rubric (7 dims) + set review-time threshold
Description: Write the 7-dimension scoring rubric on a 1-10 scale, with 6 anchored to matches-manual quality, and set the concrete review-time threshold.

Name: S1.6 Curate 3–6 grounding sources (sources/g*.md)
Description: Find and trim 3–6 strong sources to excerpt files: definitions, risk taxonomy, Lehman-case facts.

Name: S1.7 Hand-author Domain Model (deep m1_s1 + thin m1)
Description: Author the domain-model JSON: deep for m1_s1, thin stubs for sibling subtopics; register source ids.

Name: S1.8 Build llm.py (call/retry/token-log/cache) + .env
Description: Build the Anthropic SDK wrapper: call, retry, token/cost logging, prompt-hash cache; wire .env.

Name: S1.9 Run first throwaway sample (smoke-test plumbing)
Description: Run one throwaway end-to-end sample to smoke-test the plumbing (DM + sources → model call → output).

Name: S1.M Milestone: quality bar + inputs in place
Description: Gate (Mon 15 Jun): rubric, benchmark, sources, domain model and plumbing all in place.

Name: S2.1 v0.2 schema bump (schema + sample + stub + integrity.py)
Description: Bump the Content Package schema to v0.2 (claims[] + verification) and update the sample, stub, and integrity.py together.

Name: S2.2 Write Course Content prompt + generation logic
Description: Write the Course Content generation prompt and the per-asset generation logic in student_content.py.

Name: S2.3 Generate Course Content (make-or-break) + inspect ★
Description: Generate the Course Content asset and inspect it for depth and coverage — the make-or-break asset.

Name: S2.4 Write prompts for rest of core 5 (LO/Summary/Case/Assess)
Description: Write prompts for the other 4 core assets (Learning Objectives, Summary, Case Study, Assessment), conditioned on the Course Content.

Name: S2.5 student_content_step thin adapter → assemble v0.2 package
Description: Turn student_content_step into a thin adapter: call generation, assemble the v0.2 package, return it.

Name: S2.6 Generate core 5 end-to-end through pipeline ⚌
Description: Run the full pipeline end-to-end to produce all 5 core assets as one v0.2 package; debug integration.

Name: S2.7 Write contract/skeleton tests (schema-valid v0.2 + integrity, LLM mocked)
Description: Contract tests per Plan §H: schema-valid v0.2, all expected assets present, claims resolve to grounding ids, integrity.py passes; LLM mocked for plumbing. Author Tue against the schema/stub; run green against the Wed end-to-end output. Fills the otherwise-idle Tue 16 Jun.

Name: S2.M Milestone: end-to-end run, real core-5 content
Description: Gate (Mon 22 Jun): end-to-end run produces real, grounded core-5 content; contract tests green.

Name: S3.1 Build verification agent (adversarial, per-claim verdicts)
Description: Build the verification agent: adversarial, asset-by-asset, writing per-claim support verdicts into claims[].

Name: S3.2 Build eval/scoring + two-tier compare + scorecard
Description: Build the eval/scoring tool: 1-10 rubric scoring, agent-vs-manual comparison, and a per-run scorecard JSON.

Name: S3.3 Run verification + first baseline scorecard ⚌
Description: Run verification + scoring on the core 5 for the first baseline scorecard vs the manual.

Name: S3.4 Improve-&-re-measure loop (tune→regen→verify→score) ⚌⟳
Description: Iterate: tune prompts, regenerate, re-verify, re-score until the core 5 meet or beat the manual. Spread across Tue–Thu so no person exceeds ~6h/day (the week's only slack lives in this loop). (Main quality-risk task.)

Name: S3.5 Generate light 4 (Imp.Person/DYK/Activities/Resources)
Description: Generate the 4 light assets (Important Person, Did-you-know, Activities, Resources) and their prompts. Low-intensity fill — slot into the week's only gaps (≈1h Mon + 2h Wed), not onto the full Tue/Thu. Off the critical path, so flex it first if any day runs hot.

Name: S3.6 Wire feedback-driven revision loop (targeted regen)
Description: Wire the feedback-driven revision loop so verifier flags drive targeted per-asset regeneration. Spread Wed–Thu (2h/day) alongside the improve loop. Deferred-priority — slips first if the week runs tight.

Name: S3.7 Verify + score all 9 (incl. light 4)
Description: Run verification + scoring across all 9 assets, including the light 4.

Name: S3.8 Blind A/B human scoring + timed review ≤ threshold ⚌ ◆DONE-GATE
Description: Done gate: blind A/B human scoring (agent vs manual) + a timed human review against the threshold.

Name: S3.9 Phase 1 handoff doc + update master context + lessons
Description: Write the Phase 1 handoff doc, update master context, and capture the reusable lessons.

Name: S3.10 (stretch) 2nd-subtopic generalization check
Description: (Stretch — uncommitted) Post-gate 2nd-subtopic run to check prompts generalize. Only if the gate passes with time to spare; first task to drop. No committed slot in Sprint 3 — every working day already sits at the ~6h ceiling.

Name: S3.M Milestone: PHASE 1 DONE (DoD checklist complete)
Description: Gate (Mon 29 Jun): Phase 1 done — all 9 assets ≥ manual, human review in minutes not a rewrite.
